additional_info.subject: RE: 0412415 - ID0407175-DC/Si-D/AE-[MP / R8 170002423] Charger stuck at Hello Screen (C1) CRM:00646000027
additional_info.body:
Dear Basheer,
I hope all is well with you. Please be aware that yesterday, we troubleshot the charger and revived it from stuck booting. Upon checking with the temporary HMI, we observed that the touch controller is not transmitting any data to the PLC. Due to the time constraints yesterday, we were unable to check the ribbon cable on the HMI controller. But Mr. Umesh confirmed that he will be checking the same and updating us. Thank you very much for being understanding and patient.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Sambath.K.S

additional_info.subject: Status Update : 13/06/2025
additional_info.body:
Issue: Touch controller from the temporary HMI does not responded
Action Plan: Need to check the ribbon cable for the same or try new HMI
Action Taken on 13/06/2025
-
Found issue with FC12 and cleared the same
Flashed Cfast card & restored config
Charger went to failsafe with Router issue: router-update.service loaded failed failed router-update.service
Changed router setting and rebooted the charger
Charger came online after that with HMI non responsive
checked PLC -USB healthiness - Found Ok - Replaced the USB cable -> No response from HMI controller side
Need to check the ribbon cable or check with another HMI
